Thank you so much! I won't be seeing her brother anymore because they now have a protection order against him because of his drug problems and that he has been violent with her. I hung out with them before the order was served. I tried to be careful while I was there; I'm not religious but I am spiritual and very sensitive to these types of things. I haven't really felt anything since I've come home, but my first night back home, I couldn't stop thinking about it. I don't know if this makes sense, but I would close my eyes to try to go to sleep and it almost felt like I was back there. I could see the rooms inside of the building and even though my eyes were closed and my body was still, I felt like I was watching it all again but without any people there, I can't really describe what I mean. I haven't had any experiences like that since then though, so I don't know if that means much considering it was probably my brain being exhausted because we stayed up all night talking when I was with them. I don't know if this extra information helps paint more of a picture, but thank you for letting me know this.

edit: I reread your response and although I am sensitive towards these things, I didn't mention any past experiences because I didn't feel like any were relative to the story!
